features: New Engine for Credit Notes and Reversals: the system now processes reversals in a totally secure and automatic way. A new 'accounting guardian' checks that every single cent matches before saving the operation: if it detects the slightest discrepancy, it blocks everything to protect your accounting from errors.

Foolproof Tax and Reserve Fund Management: permanently resolved the calculation of Withholding Taxes on Credit Notes, preventing you from paying undue F24 taxes. Furthermore, if you reverse an expense, the money automatically returns to the Reserve Fund you took it from, and the system 'cleans up' by removing empty budget items.

Previous Debt Invoices and Bug Fixes: we have definitively fixed the issues related to entering historical debts. Now a new panel assists you by calculating the exact net bank transfer to make, showing you the difference with the debt on the balance sheet, and triggering a red alarm if you are paying a 5-year-old invoice (saving you from legal headaches related to statute of limitations).

Flexible Management of Out-of-Budget Expenses: you now have complete freedom of action for invoices that exceed the budget. You can choose to cover them using a Reserve Fund, send the expense to the Year-End Adjustment (Conguaglio), or create an 'Unexpected Expense' with an Installment Plan. Plus: by clicking on an uncovered expense directly from the Dashboard widget, the system immediately redirects you to the installment plan creation page, pre-filled and ready to go.

Clear and Transparent Chart of Accounts: we have strictly separated the budget approved in the assembly from unexpected expenses. Now the interface shows you two distinct totals so as not to inflate the balance sheet numbers. Items created by unexpected invoices are protected and cannot be modified by mistake, ensuring full legal compliance (Art. 1130-bis).

Vault for Reserve Funds: the system now recognizes if a fund is untouchable (e.g., Severance Pay or Renovations) and locks it by default to prevent you from using that money for ordinary expenses. If you have an emergency, you can unlock it, but the system will ask you to note the resolution or reason, leaving a perfect trail for any accounting audits.

Highly Readable Accounting Tables: we have redesigned the funds and resources screens. Now numbers and decimals are perfectly aligned, just like in a bank statement. Colored labels tell you at a glance if a fund is free (green), locked (red), or force-unlocked (purple).

General Stability and Secure Saves: we have reinforced the system 'behind the scenes' to ensure that no data (such as selecting a property unit in an invoice) is ever lost during saving. The application is now much smoother, robust, and responsive to your commands.
